prompt: Use case: game obstacle sprite concept for FIELD-002 Royal Road. Create ONE isolated short roadside stone column, genuinely transparent square canvas. Three-quarter top-down orthographic view, visible top and front, lower broken guard-post column of pale blue-grey stone with a simple square base and a thick, chipped cap, compact approximately square footprint, no tall slender tower. Stylized 2D hand-drawn storybook cutout art, chunky silhouette, thick slightly irregular charcoal-plum outline, simple cel shading, matte desaturated stone, restrained paper texture. The column should read as a solid player-only obstacle at small gameplay scale and stand distinct from a natural boulder. Generous clear padding and a stable ground contact at bottom. No ground shadow, no sign, no lettering, no flags, no effects, no frame, no 3D render or pixel art. At least 1024px square.
